terra.problem: The passage says it is night, not the middle of the night.
The warm-porch and swinging-door lines do not land as a clear joke.
The text does not say she is standing there when her heart pounds. She rises in the next verse.
The passage does not say she was in bed.
The text gives her questions but does not say she was grumbling.
Her failure to find him does not establish that she does not know where he went.
Papa comments on his own choice not to joke instead of staying with the passage.
The daughters address her as most beautiful, but the text does not say they respect her.
A raven has no hair. The passage compares the blackness of his hair to a raven.
It suggests the beating is why she would not send anyone to the watchmen. The text gives no such reason.
The description mentions his legs, not his feet, and continues to his mouth afterward.
The daughters offer to seek him with her, but the text does not say they begin a search together.
The text records an offer to seek him, not that the daughters go looking alongside her.
The text does not specify that she answers right away.
The text does not say how long her search lasted or that all these events took place during one night.
